pages.en:
.10
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 37
Date 16-2-16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
10th February 1916
Sir,
With reference to the report of yesterday's date regarding the arrival of two high military officers from Peking it is now said that these officers have come here to arrange for the transfer of the 4th Division, which comprises about 1,500 men from the Kiangnan Arsenal to Hupeh. Troops from the latter place will be sent to Shanghai to take their place. Previous to the assassination of Admiral Tseng the 4th division was stationed at Sungkiang. This division came to Shanghai with General Yang and has been under his direct control ever since.
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities will test guns within the next few days. This work may begin to day.
It is reported that there is great consternation in higher rebel circles in Shanghai where information has been received that Yuan's local assassination corps will become active soon.
It is reported that the Chinese officials in Shanghai have received instructions to have no private dealings with General Aoki.
Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
[手写批注]
pages.zh:
.10
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）
刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 37 号
日期 16-2-16

上海工部局。
1916年2月10日

先生：

关于昨日有关两名来自北京的高级军官抵达的报告，现据悉这些军官来此是为了安排第四师从江南兵工厂调往湖北的事宜，该师约有1,500人。湖北方面的部队将被派往上海接替其防务。在曾海军上将遇刺之前，第四师驻防于松江。该师随杨将军来到上海，此后一直由其直接指挥。

据报，兵工厂当局将在未来几天内测试枪支。这项工作可能今天就开始。

据报，上海反叛高层圈子中人心惶惶，因为他们收到消息说袁世凯的地方暗杀队即将展开行动。

据报，上海的中國官员已接到指示，不得与青木将军进行任何私人往来。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
首席探长。
警司。
[手写批注]
